name: Band External Rotation
cues: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand side-on to it
Hold the band in your far hand, elbow bent to 90 degrees
Rotate your forearm outward, keeping your elbow at your side
Return slowly without letting your torso turn

qa.note: Wave 3b 2026-10-09: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: Right arm only: elbow fixed at 90 at elevation 12 on the towel, humeral rot -52 (external) to +38 (fist in front of the stomach at x -0.06). That is a 90 deg arc and matches 211. The band runs from the post at elbow height (fist at 1.09-1.19 m) and stays at least 209 mm off the trunk. Nothing turns but the forearm.
